english: A live great white swimming underwater. Video lets the player see the animal’s surprisingly smooth, controlled movement rather than only its famous silhouette.
quebec_french: Un grand requin blanc vivant qui nage sous l'eau. La vidéo permet de voir le mouvement étonnamment fluide et maîtrisé de l'animal, plutôt que seulement sa célèbre silhouette.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Gremly Media' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild great white shark at Isla Guadalupe, Mexico, photographed in natural light.
quebec_french: Un grand requin blanc sauvage à Isla Guadalupe, au Mexique, photographié en lumière naturelle.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Terry Goss (Pterantula)' + license 'CC BY 2.5' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild tiger shark swimming in the Bahamas. The dark vertical markings along its body give the species its name.
quebec_french: Un requin-tigre sauvage qui nage aux Bahamas. Les marques verticales sombres le long de son corps donnent son nom à l'espèce.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Mark Pfleghar' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild tiger shark in the Bahamas, with the characteristic striped pattern clearly visible.
quebec_french: Un requin-tigre sauvage aux Bahamas, dont le motif rayé caractéristique est bien visible.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Albert Kok' + license 'CC BY-SA 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild whale shark swimming in the Maldives. Seeing it beside a human gives a sense of the extraordinary scale of the world’s largest living fish.
quebec_french: Un requin-baleine sauvage qui nage aux Maldives. Le voir à côté d'un humain donne une idée de l'échelle extraordinaire du plus grand poisson vivant au monde.
notes: Archive video; credit 'David Rojo' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild whale shark feeding near La Paz, Mexico, with its enormous filter-feeding mouth open.
quebec_french: Un requin-baleine sauvage qui se nourrit près de La Paz, au Mexique, la bouche énorme de filtreur ouverte.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Matthew T Rader' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild great hammerhead in the Bahamas. Video shows how the unusually broad head moves as the shark swims.
quebec_french: Un grand requin-marteau sauvage aux Bahamas. La vidéo montre comment la tête, exceptionnellement large, bouge pendant que le requin nage.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Mark Pfleghar' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild great hammerhead feeding near Bimini, Bahamas.
quebec_french: Un grand requin-marteau sauvage qui se nourrit près de Bimini, aux Bahamas.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Stevelaycock21' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Research in action: a live common thresher temporarily aboard during scientific catch-tag-release work, with water being used to ventilate its gills during handling before release.
quebec_french: Recherche en action : un requin-renard commun vivant, temporairement à bord pendant des travaux scientifiques de capture, de marquage et de remise à l'eau; on utilise de l'eau pour ventiler ses branchies pendant la manipulation, avant la remise à l'eau.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'SWFSC Large Pelagics Program (NOAA)' + license 'Public domain' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Wild lemon sharks at Tiger Beach in the Bahamas — a trimmed excerpt showing the clearest full-body footage.
quebec_french: Des requins-citrons sauvages à Tiger Beach, aux Bahamas — un extrait raccourci montrant les images les plus nettes de l'animal en entier.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Diver Jackie' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild lemon shark in the Bahamas accompanied by remoras.
quebec_french: Un requin-citron sauvage aux Bahamas, accompagné de rémoras.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Albert Kok' + license 'CC BY-SA 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A close view of a nurse shark ventilating its gills, showing the rhythmic movement used to keep water flowing across them.
quebec_french: Vue rapprochée d'un requin-nourrice qui ventile ses branchies, montrant le mouvement rythmique qui maintient l'eau en circulation sur celles-ci.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Jon Houseman' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild nurse shark at Gray’s Reef National Marine Sanctuary.
quebec_french: Un requin-nourrice sauvage au sanctuaire marin national de Gray's Reef.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A goblin shark underwater. Its long flattened snout is one of the most distinctive features of this rarely observed deep-sea species.
quebec_french: Un requin-lutin sous l'eau. Son long museau aplati est l'une des caractéristiques les plus distinctives de cette espèce de grands fonds rarement observée.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Michigan State University/USFWS' + license 'public domain (USFWS)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A preserved goblin shark with its jaws extended. Goblin sharks can rapidly project their jaws forward to seize prey.
quebec_french: Un requin-lutin conservé, les mâchoires déployées. Les requins-lutins peuvent projeter rapidement leurs mâchoires vers l'avant pour saisir leurs proies.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Dianne Bray / Museum Victoria' + license 'CC BY 3.0 AU' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A sand tiger shark cruising through the water. Despite its dramatic protruding teeth, its appearance is much more intimidating than its typical behaviour.
quebec_french: Un requin-taureau qui croise dans l'eau. Malgré ses dents saillantes spectaculaires, son apparence est bien plus intimidante que son comportement habituel.
notes: Archive motion; credit 'Erin Rod' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild sand tiger shark off Cronulla, Australia. Its long narrow teeth remain conspicuous even when the mouth is mostly closed.
quebec_french: Un requin-taureau sauvage au large de Cronulla, en Australie. Ses longues dents étroites restent bien visibles même quand la bouche est presque fermée.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Bryce Watts-Parker' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild Galápagos shark at Kure Atoll in the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands. Despite its name, the species occurs far beyond the Galápagos.
quebec_french: Un requin des Galápagos sauvage à l'atoll de Kure, dans les îles hawaïennes du Nord-Ouest. Malgré son nom, l'espèce vit bien au-delà des Galápagos.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Claire Fackler/NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild Galápagos shark over reef habitat in the Northwestern Hawaiian Islands.
quebec_french: Un requin des Galápagos sauvage au-dessus d'un habitat récifal dans les îles hawaïennes du Nord-Ouest.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Dr. Dwayne Meadows, NOAA/NMFS/OPR' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Two shortfin makos swimming in open water. Their narrow, streamlined bodies are built for high-speed swimming.
quebec_french: Deux requins-taupes bleus qui nagent en pleine eau. Leurs corps étroits et fuselés sont faits pour nager à grande vitesse.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Mark Conlin, SWFSC Large Pelagics Program' + license 'public domain (NOAA/SWFSC)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A shortfin mako underwater, showing the pointed snout and streamlined body characteristic of this fast open-ocean shark.
quebec_french: Un requin-taupe bleu sous l'eau, montrant le museau pointu et le corps fuselé caractéristiques de ce requin rapide de pleine mer.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'SWFSC/NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA/SWFSC)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild basking shark cruising just below the Atlantic surface.
quebec_french: Un requin-pèlerin sauvage qui croise juste sous la surface de l'Atlantique.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Green Fire Productions' + license 'CC BY 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild epaulette shark on the Great Barrier Reef. The large dark “epaulette” spot behind the pectoral fin gives the species its name.
quebec_french: Un requin-épaulette sauvage sur la Grande Barrière de corail. La grande tache sombre en forme d'épaulette derrière la nageoire pectorale donne son nom à l'espèce.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Richard Ling' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild epaulette shark on Great Barrier Reef habitat. Its broad paired fins help it maneuver across complex reef terrain.
quebec_french: Un requin-épaulette sauvage dans l'habitat de la Grande Barrière de corail. Ses larges nageoires paires l'aident à manœuvrer sur un terrain récifal complexe.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Anne Hoggett / Lizard Island Research Station' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A blacktip reef shark seen from above at Lady Musgrave Island, showing how comfortably the species moves through very shallow reef water.
quebec_french: Un requin à pointes noires vu d'en haut à Lady Musgrave Island, montrant avec quelle aisance l'espèce évolue dans l'eau récifale très peu profonde.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Adam Fish' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Blacktip reef sharks in shallow water at Moorea. The split-level view shows how closely this species uses lagoons and reef shallows.
quebec_french: Des requins à pointes noires en eau peu profonde à Moorea. La vue à mi-niveau montre à quel point cette espèce fréquente les lagons et les eaux récifales peu profondes.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Charles J. Sharp' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A group of wild whitetip reef sharks at Cocos Island — a trimmed excerpt of the clearest schooling footage. Whitetips often gather around reef structure and may rest together during the day.
quebec_french: Un groupe de requins corail sauvages à l'île Cocos — un extrait raccourci des images les plus nettes de bancs. Les requins corail se rassemblent souvent autour des structures récifales et peuvent se reposer ensemble pendant la journée.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Blane Henderson' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A whitetip reef shark resting inside a Red Sea cave. Unlike sharks that must swim continuously, whitetips can pump water over their gills while resting.
quebec_french: Un requin corail qui se repose dans une grotte de la mer Rouge. Contrairement aux requins qui doivent nager sans arrêt, les requins corail peuvent pomper l'eau sur leurs branchies pendant qu'ils se reposent.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Derek Keats from Johannesburg, South Africa' + license 'CC BY 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild blue shark in the Azores. Its slim body and exceptionally long pectoral fins are adaptations for life in the open ocean.
quebec_french: Un requin bleu sauvage aux Açores. Son corps élancé et ses nageoires pectorales exceptionnellement longues sont des adaptations à la vie en pleine mer.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Diego Delso' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild blue shark photographed by NOAA. The species’ deep-blue back and pale underside create striking open-ocean countershading.
quebec_french: Un requin bleu sauvage photographié par la NOAA. Le dos bleu profond et le ventre pâle de l'espèce créent un remarquable contre-ombrage de pleine mer.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Mark Conlin/NMFS' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A porbeagle, a cold-water relative of the great white and mako. The white patch at the rear base of the first dorsal fin is a useful identification feature.
quebec_french: Un requin-taupe commun, un parent d'eau froide du grand requin blanc et du requin-taupe bleu. La tache blanche à l'arrière de la base de la première nageoire dorsale est un trait utile pour l'identification.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NMFS, E. Hoffmayer, S. Iglésias and R. McAuley' + license 'public domain (NOAA/NMFS)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild silky shark in the Bahamas. The species is named for the unusually smooth texture of its skin.
quebec_french: Un requin soyeux sauvage aux Bahamas. L'espèce doit son nom à la texture exceptionnellement lisse de sa peau.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Joi Ito from Inbamura, Japan' + license 'CC BY 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A silky shark at an offshore Red Sea reef. Silkies are wide-ranging oceanic predators often associated with shelf edges, seamounts, and schooling fish.
quebec_french: Un requin soyeux sur un récif au large de la mer Rouge. Les requins soyeux sont des prédateurs océaniques à vaste répartition, souvent associés aux rebords de plateau, aux monts sous-marins et aux bancs de poissons.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Johanlantz at English Wikipedia' + license 'CC BY-SA 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild oceanic whitetip in the Red Sea. Its broad rounded fins and pale fin tips create one of the most distinctive silhouettes among open-ocean sharks.
quebec_french: Un requin océanique sauvage en mer Rouge. Ses larges nageoires arrondies et l'extrémité pâle de ses nageoires créent l'une des silhouettes les plus distinctives parmi les requins de pleine mer.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Cvf-ps' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild oceanic whitetip at Elphinstone Reef accompanied by pilot fish, a common association for this pelagic shark.
quebec_french: Un requin océanique sauvage au récif d'Elphinstone, accompagné de poissons-pilotes, une association courante pour ce requin pélagique.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'No machine-readable author provided. Peterkoelbl assumed (based on copyright claims).' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.5' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild broadnose sevengill shark in False Bay, South Africa. Its blunt head and spotted body give it a very different profile from most familiar sharks.
quebec_french: Un requin à sept branchies sauvage à False Bay, en Afrique du Sud. Sa tête obtuse et son corps tacheté lui donnent un profil très différent de celui de la plupart des requins familiers.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Aaron Scheiner' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A broadnose sevengill shark, also called a cowshark, at Shark Alley near Cape Town. Seven gill openings are visible behind the head; most modern sharks have five.
quebec_french: Un requin à sept branchies, aussi appelé requin-vache, à Shark Alley, près du Cap. Sept ouvertures branchiales sont visibles derrière la tête; la plupart des requins modernes en ont cinq.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Peter Southwood' + license 'CC BY-SA 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild bronze whaler near Gansbaai, South Africa. This shark was drawn near the boat using bait during a cage-diving encounter.
quebec_french: Un requin cuivré sauvage près de Gansbaai, en Afrique du Sud. Ce requin a été attiré près du bateau avec un appât pendant une rencontre en cage.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Bernard DUPONT from FRANCE' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A bronze whaler, also known as a copper shark, cruising near a baited cage-diving site off South Africa.
quebec_french: Un requin cuivré qui croise près d'un site de plongée en cage avec appât, au large de l'Afrique du Sud.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Bernard DUPONT from FRANCE' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A frilled shark in its deep-water habitat. This image comes from the first known video footage of the species observed alive in the wild.
quebec_french: Un requin-lézard dans son habitat de grands fonds. Cette image provient des premières images vidéo connues de l'espèce observée vivante dans la nature.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Frilled shark jaws showing rows of small three-pointed teeth adapted for gripping slippery prey such as squid.
quebec_french: Mâchoires de requin-lézard montrant des rangées de petites dents à trois pointes, adaptées pour saisir des proies glissantes comme les calmars.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Nesnad' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild adult zebra shark in the Celebes Sea. Adults lose the bold juvenile stripes and develop the leopard-like spots seen here.
quebec_french: Un requin-zèbre adulte sauvage dans la mer de Célèbes. Les adultes perdent les rayures marquées des jeunes et développent les taches léopard visibles ici.
notes: Archive photo; credit '(c) Tony Tong, some rights reserved (CC BY)' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: An adult zebra shark showing the species’ long tail and distinctive spotted adult pattern.
quebec_french: Un requin-zèbre adulte montrant la longue queue de l'espèce et son motif adulte tacheté distinctif.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Daniel Sasse' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Research in action: a salmon shark passes through NOAA’s CamTrawl survey system, which photographs marine animals underwater and allows researchers to collect data without bringing the animal aboard.
quebec_french: Recherche en action : un requin-saumon passe dans le système d'enquête CamTrawl de la NOAA, qui photographie les animaux marins sous l'eau et permet aux chercheurs de recueillir des données sans amener l'animal à bord.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A salmon shark carrying an external “spaghetti” tag. These simple numbered tags allow researchers to identify animals again if they are later encountered or recaptured.
quebec_french: Un requin-saumon portant une étiquette externe « spaghetti ». Ces étiquettes numérotées simples permettent aux chercheurs d'identifier à nouveau les animaux s'ils sont rencontrés ou recapturés plus tard.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Dave Clausen, NOAA-AFSC' + license 'public domain (NOAA-AFSC)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild school of scalloped hammerheads at Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Scalloped hammerheads can gather in large daytime schools around oceanic islands and seamounts.
quebec_french: Un banc sauvage de requins-marteaux halicornes à l'île Cocos, au Costa Rica. Les requins-marteaux halicornes peuvent se rassembler en grands bancs diurnes autour des îles océaniques et des monts sous-marins.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Barry Peters' + license 'CC BY 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild scalloped hammerhead off Baja California. The curved leading edge of the head, with its characteristic central indentation, gives the species its “scalloped” name.
quebec_french: Un requin-marteau halicorne sauvage au large de la Basse-Californie. Le bord avant incurvé de la tête, avec son indentation centrale caractéristique, donne son nom « halicorne » à l'espèce.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Diego Delso' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild smooth hammerhead near New Zealand. Unlike the scalloped hammerhead, the front edge of its broad head forms a smooth curve without a central notch.
quebec_french: Un requin-marteau lisse sauvage près de la Nouvelle-Zélande. Contrairement au requin-marteau halicorne, le bord avant de sa large tête forme une courbe lisse sans encoche centrale.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Shaun Lee' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A smooth hammerhead passes the NOAA vessel Albatross IV off New Jersey. The source description reports hundreds of hammerheads moving northeast that day, offering an unusual glimpse of the species travelling in numbers.
quebec_french: Un requin-marteau lisse passe devant le navire Albatross IV de la NOAA, au large du New Jersey. La description de la source signale des centaines de requins-marteaux se déplaçant vers le nord-est ce jour-là, un aperçu inhabituel de l'espèce voyageant en nombre.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA Corps' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A bonnethead shark showing the species’ compact, rounded shovel-shaped head. Bonnetheads are the smallest members of the hammerhead family. (Aquarium animal — wild material for this species is scarce.)
quebec_french: Un requin-marteau tiburo montrant la tête compacte et arrondie en forme de pelle de l'espèce. Les requins-marteaux tiburo sont les plus petits membres de la famille des requins-marteaux. (Animal d'aquarium — le matériel sauvage pour cette espèce est rare.)
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Mills Baker' + license 'CC BY 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A bonnethead turning through the water, giving another view of the species’ unusually narrow cephalofoil. (Aquarium animal; image intentionally retained despite softness.)
quebec_french: Un requin-marteau tiburo qui tourne dans l'eau, offrant une autre vue du céphalofoil exceptionnellement étroit de l'espèce. (Animal d'aquarium; image conservée intentionnellement malgré son manque de netteté.)
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Jh12' + license 'public domain' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild bull shark off Playa del Carmen, Mexico. Bull sharks are powerfully built coastal sharks capable of moving between salt water and fresh water.
quebec_french: Un requin-bouledogue sauvage au large de Playa del Carmen, au Mexique. Les requins-bouledogues sont des requins côtiers puissamment bâtis, capables de passer de l'eau salée à l'eau douce.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'João D’Andretta' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Research in Action: “Granma,” an individually recognized female bull shark at Fiji’s Shark Reef Marine Reserve. Long-term observations of recognizable individuals help researchers follow how sharks use the site over time.
quebec_french: Recherche en action : « Granma », une femelle requin-bouledogue reconnue individuellement à la réserve marine Shark Reef, aux Fidji. Les observations à long terme d'individus reconnaissables aident les chercheurs à suivre la façon dont les requins utilisent le site au fil du temps.
notes: Archive video; credit 'J. Brunnschweiler & H. Baensch (PLOS ONE)' + license 'CC BY 2.5' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild grey reef shark in Palau. Grey reef sharks are strongly associated with coral reefs and often patrol drop-offs, channels, and current-swept reef edges.
quebec_french: Un requin gris de récif sauvage à Palau. Les requins gris de récif sont fortement associés aux récifs coralliens et patrouillent souvent les tombants, les chenaux et les bords de récif balayés par les courants.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Ioannis Magouras' + license 'CC BY 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A wild grey reef shark near Sipadan, moving through the reef environment that gives the species its name.
quebec_french: Un requin gris de récif sauvage près de Sipadan, évoluant dans l'environnement récifal qui donne son nom à l'espèce.
notes: Archive video; credit 'Emma Tolmie' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Caribbean reef sharks at Tiger Beach in the Bahamas, sharing the water with other large coastal sharks — lemon and bull sharks are also visible in the frame. Reef communities are not single-species spaces.
quebec_french: Des requins de récif des Caraïbes à Tiger Beach, aux Bahamas, partageant l'eau avec d'autres grands requins côtiers — des requins-citrons et des requins-bouledogues sont aussi visibles dans le cadre. Les communautés récifales ne sont pas des espaces à une seule espèce.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Dennis Hipp' + license 'CC0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: Wild Caribbean reef sharks swimming near divers in Nassau, Bahamas, showing the species moving naturally through its reef habitat. (Source material was trimmed in length with audio removed before our use.)
quebec_french: Des requins de récif des Caraïbes sauvages qui nagent près de plongeurs à Nassau, aux Bahamas, montrant l'espèce qui évolue naturellement dans son habitat récifal. (Le matériel source a été raccourci en longueur et l'audio a été retiré avant notre utilisation.)
notes: Archive video; credit 'Rico Singleton' + license 'CC BY 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A sandbar shark in Hawaiian waters. The species is named for its strong association with shallow coastal shelves, bays, banks, and sandy-bottomed habitat.
quebec_french: Un requin gris dans les eaux hawaïennes. L'espèce doit son nom à sa forte association avec les plateaux côtiers peu profonds, les baies, les bancs et les habitats à fond sablonneux.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Narrissa Spies' + license 'CC BY-SA 4.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A sandbar shark documented by NOAA. Sandbar sharks are recognizable by their notably tall first dorsal fin and heavy-bodied coastal-shark profile.
quebec_french: Un requin gris documenté par la NOAA. Les requins gris se reconnaissent à leur première nageoire dorsale remarquablement haute et à leur profil de requin côtier massif.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A dusky shark at Sea World Australia — a captive animal, photographed here cruising alongside a cobia.
quebec_french: Un requin sombre à Sea World Australia — un animal captif, photographié ici en train de croiser aux côtés d'un cobia.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Happy Little Nomad' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A dusky shark documented during NOAA research operations.
quebec_french: Un requin sombre documenté pendant des opérations de recherche de la NOAA.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'NOAA' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A silvertip shark in clean profile — the pale margins edging the fins are clearly visible.
quebec_french: Un requin à pointes argentées en profil net — les marges pâles bordant les nageoires sont bien visibles.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Albert Kok' + license 'CC BY-SA 3.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A spinner shark caught mid-leap — the real airborne animal performing its namesake spin.
quebec_french: Un requin tisserand pris en plein saut — le vrai animal aérien exécutant son saut caractéristique.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Niall Perrins' + license 'CC BY-NC' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: NOAA Apex Predators Program species reference photograph.
quebec_french: Photographie de référence du requin tisserand, programme Apex Predators de la NOAA.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Apex Predators Program, NOAA/NEFSC' + license 'public domain (NOAA)' preserved exactly in build (not translated).

english: A spotted wobbegong camouflaged against the reef at Shelly Beach, Manly — nearly invisible until you know where to look.
quebec_french: Un requin-tapis tacheté camouflé contre le récif à Shelly Beach, Manly — presque invisible tant qu'on ne sait pas où regarder.
notes: Archive photo; credit 'Sylke Rohrlach' + license 'CC BY-SA 2.0' preserved exactly in build (not translated).
